extracted.name: Apple Almond Crunch Salad
extracted.description: This easy-to-assemble salad with almonds combines crunchy apples and nuts with sweet golden raisins, briny feta cheese, and a tangy raspberry dressing.
ingredient_lines: 1 large tart apple, cored and chopped
instruction_lines: Toss salad greens, apple, almonds, feta, onion, and raisins together in a large salad bowl until well blended.
Apply salad dressing to individual servings.
